links.comparator_used: Gemini responses generated without PHR context (query only), compared with responses given a basic PHR summary or full clinical notes
links.outcome: Helpfulness of answers to patient health queries (also safety, accuracy, relevance and personalization)
links.effect: Significant improvements in helpfulness for all question types with PHR data (p < 0.001, paired t-test); potential gains in safety, accuracy, relevance and personalization
links.tradeoff: The PHR evaluation framework found gaps in LLM understanding of complex PHRs, such as temporal disorientation, and rare but meaningful confabulations.
links.quote: We see significant improvements in the helpfulness of answers to all question types with PHR data (p < 0.001, paired t-test).

design_hint: Providing PHR clinical data as context (grounding) to LLM answers
